capabilities: Split a note into chunks that fit Discord's character limit
Copy each chunk to the clipboard via copy buttons
Export only the selected text instead of the whole note
Strip ignored blocks and force chunk breaks with +++ markers
disambiguation: Does not post to Discord directly; it only prepares text locally and gives you chunks to copy and paste yourself.
extras: Makes no network requests; all processing is local. Flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The 4,000-character limit applies only to Discord Nitro users.
motivation: The author writes a lot in Obsidian and regularly shares text on Discord; manually splitting long notes and handling formatting oddities got annoying, so the plugin automates it.
problem: Manually splitting long notes to fit Discord's message limits and fixing formatting oddities when pasting is tedious.

relations.evidence: prepares your notes for posting on Discord

summary: Exports notes as Discord-ready text: splits them into 2,000 or 4,000 character chunks with copy buttons and optional paragraph indentation.
